prompt:
INPUT: the attached image is the approved character — her Three kingdoms card; keep her. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — the female personification of Xu Shu of the Three Kingdoms, seen in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change, and her hair may be worn differently only as SCENE's Hair line says. Her Three Kingdoms identity shows ONLY as a small accessory, an object around her, or the object PROP says she holds — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume.

DESIGN (accessory hints only): her legend — a former knight-errant in a scholar's robe over a swordswoman's belt, filial devotion, quiet melancholy, a vow never to devise a plan for the enemy, a folded letter tucked at her belt — may inform at most one small accessory, a hair ornament or an object beside her, in its palette (jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade, with small accents of deep navy blue and black lacquer (Cao Wei)). The clothes keep the chosen outfit's own colours; her skin, hair and eyes stay as in the attached image.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: off duty she carries no weapon — no sword, saber, spear, glaive, halberd, bow, axe, shield or any blade in her hands, on her back or anywhere in the scene. Her signature weapon (a slim scholar's sword) appears only as one small worn accessory modelled on its shape and colours — a hair ornament, pendant, earring, brooch or belt charm a few centimetres long, clearly jewellery and not a usable weapon.

STYLE: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

AGE: the same adult woman as in the attached image — keep her own face shape, cheekbones, eye proportions and skin tone exactly; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases). Keep her face soft, feminine and attractive in every framing — never elongated, gaunt, mannish or heavy-jawed, even in close-ups, profiles or low angles.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her legend shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

SCENE (chosen):
FREE DESIGN: design the place, activity, pose, framing and outfit yourself. Start from who she is — her legend, traits and personality — and show an everyday moment that is unexpected yet feels natural for her. Make it fresh through the situation and what she is doing, not through more decoration. Avoid scenes like the recent ones listed below. Keep her face, the art style and the body and anatomy rules exactly as stated. Before drawing, write your design into the lines below, then draw it.
Recent scenes to avoid: standing; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — dries her hair with a towel; a hilltop lookout over a wide valley — standing; the grand staircase of an old castle — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; her living room with a deep sofa — sitting on the ground; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — holds a white feather fan in both hands in front of her chest; her crew cabin aboard a starship — holds a book closed against her chest; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — standing; a hanfu photo studio with costume racks — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; an inn kitchen with clay stoves — dries her hair with a towel; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — holds a folding fan open near her chest; a rocky coast path with tide pools — holds a paper kite on a string's string up; a quiet library reading room with tall bookshelves — writes in a notebook with a pen on the table.
Place: the tiled steps of a quiet outdoor resort pool beside a row of unlabelled waterproof storage pods
Activity: testing a small transparent waterproof letter capsule before swimming across the pool, turning its lid with both hands; the detachable outer swim wrap has caught on an open storage-pod latch and lifted at one hip, exposing her swimsuit-covered hip and upper thigh while the suit stays secure
Pose: perched sideways on a broad dry pool step, one knee bent toward her and the other leg lowered into the water, torso turning gently toward the capsule
Framing: full-body three-quarter side view from a slightly raised natural camera position, face clearly visible in three-quarter profile and both hands in frame
Outfit family (required): swimwear — any swimwear outfit; you may pick one from our outfit catalog (outfit-catalog.md in this pack) or design your own, but prefer one that is not in it.
Situation (required): a situational exposure moment of your own design that fits the scene — prefer one that is not among ours: clothes soaked by rain or a splash, clothes caught by a strong gust of wind, a top worn half undone, a strap slipped off the shoulder.
Outfit: a fully lined coral swim bustier with a sculpted square neckline and wide curved shoulder bands, matching scallop-edged high-cut swim briefs, and a short detachable translucent aqua hip wrap; secure opaque chest and hip coverage, a tiny sword charm on the capsule cord
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; intimate areas covered

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, armor, regalia, ornaments, mecha plates or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her Three Kingdoms identity belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her faction's palette, armor, robes or regalia.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera exactly as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same. No default card pose, no default front-facing portrait.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

AVOID: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
